title: Lab REST contract
description: HTTP API fundamentals with standards-grounded Node.js examples, locally executable positive and negative contracts, and a complete real HTTP capstone.
objectives: Build a loopback-only Node HTTP API with bounded JSON body parsing, consistent statuses, idempotency keys, filtering, ETags and RFC 9457 problem responses, and verify them over fetch.
Repair the http-local-rest-contract failing instructor contract.
Explain the production limitation of a local Node HTTP exercise.
rubric: I can apply the HTTP semantics for lab rest contract.
I can reproduce and fix the 10.02.08 defect with real Node or fetch APIs.
I can explain the security or durability work needed before deployment.
